h1: Custom WooCommerce plugins for the feature you need
overview: If no extension does exactly what your shop needs, we build one. Tell us the feature, such as a custom product field, a delivery date picker, a special discount rule or an extra checkout step. We agree the scope in writing, then write a plugin that follows WooCommerce and WordPress standards, supports current checkout features and removes cleanly. You receive the plugin, its source code and a short guide.

faq: Yes. You receive the full source and may use, change or even sell it. There is no licence from us attached to it.
Will it work with the new block checkout?
We build for both the block checkout and the classic one when the feature needs it, and we test the one you use. We confirm this in the scope before work starts.
Is it safe to run on a live store?
We build and test on a staging copy first. You install it live only after a test order passes, and we give you a rollback step in case you need one.
What if an existing extension already does it?
We tell you honestly. A ready extension is cheaper and we can configure it for you. We build custom only when nothing fits or the options cost more than the work.
